scientific_question: Does the finite pressure sensitivity of the fixed-preload homogeneous-kernel perturbation, and its local confounding with the three-parameter interface model, persist at a rheometrically closer thin-gap geometry?

geometry.resolution_note: The 34x10 mesh preserves the R181 radial partition and approximately preserves the reference axial element size of the H/R=0.20, 34x20 case.

interpretation_if_pass: Supports persistence, at H/R=0.10, of a measurable finite-specimen sensitivity for the representative homogeneous-kernel direction together with strong local confounding by the prescribed three-parameter interface model. It does not establish experimentally calibrated interface uncertainty or an asymptotic thin-gap limit.
interpretation_if_fail: The finite-BVP application claim should be reduced to proof-of-principle at the thicker tested geometries; the exact homogeneous-kernel theorem is unaffected.
